model_description: 85,021-parameter width-9 non-causal dilated residual TCN. The model scans the bits of a sanctioned pairwise-reduced operand through a hard recurrent state and emits one base-p digit. It uses eight learned transitions for p<256, nine for p=257, and a deterministic zero fallback outside its trained width.
training_description: Trained from random initialization for 2,400 AdamW steps on independently generated synthetic Horner trajectory transitions over every prime through 257, with 15% composite-modulus augmentation and 15% random-state recovery examples. Official public expected answers were never used; Tier-2 public reduced operand pairs were explicitly excluded from training sampling. Seed 20260712.
